Name: RomanceableRasmodius_WizardPortraitsAndSprite

Description:
[b][size=5][u]Apologize：[/u][/size]
[size=2]I only use the [Romanceable Rasmodius Updated] and the [Wizard Sprites for Eskbl's Portraits] for my own gameplay,so I'm sure this mod works with these mods.However,I didn't test this mod with other mods,and this is not a complete mod,you have to use other mods to replace the portrait,sprite,etc.So,you should use either the mods I mention or other mods that I didn't test to let this mod work.
[/size]BTW,I haven't played this game for four months,bugs might happened,you can report to me through nexus.
If anything bother you,feel free to ask me,but as a noob of making mods,I might not be able to help you,Sorry<3
[size=5][u]致歉：[/u]
[/size]我自己的存档只用了[size=2][Romanceable Rasmodius Updated] 和 [Wizard Sprites for Eskbl's Portraits]这俩mods来让这个mod生效，其他替换mod我没测试过，由于这个mod并不完整，仅仅是几张图片而已，你必须使用替换mod，所以你要么用我用的那俩，要么自己找其他mods。
以及，我有四个月没碰星露谷了，可能会有bug，你可以在n网告诉我，我尽可能解决
如有不便，请见谅，毕竟这是我第一次做mod，可能会有很多bug。TT
[/size]
